grammar.q: Look at the photos ____ Matt took. They are so beautiful.
grammar.tip: 先行詞 photos 是物，關代受格用 which

grammar.q: This is the house ____ my parents want to live in.
grammar.tip: 先行詞 house 是物，用 that；介系詞 in 留句尾

grammar.q: Let's do something to help those families ____ houses collapsed（倒塌）during the earthquake.
grammar.tip: families 的房子 → 所有格 whose + 名詞

grammar.q: The small town in ____ my grandpa used to live was clean and quiet.
grammar.tip: 介系詞後的關代只能用 which（物）/ whom（人）

grammar.q: These are the fresh pears ____ I gave Lisa.
grammar.tip: 先行詞 pears 是物，受格關代用 that

grammar.q: The actress ____ you saw last night had a car accident this morning.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人，受格用 who(m)/that

grammar.q: The cheesecake ____ Edward made was delicious.
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略；不可再加 it

grammar.q: The men ____ are smart and hard-working.
grammar.tip: 省略受格關代：Johnny works with 人

grammar.q: The story Gina wrote ____.
grammar.tip: 主詞 The story 後缺動詞 → is

grammar.q: The news ____ we heard on the radio was really terrible.
grammar.tip: news 是物，受格關代用 that/which

grammar.q: The guy ____ Lily and Stella met at the party is my cousin.
grammar.tip: 先行詞 guy 是人，受格用 that/who(m)

grammar.q: Jim told me the girl ____ this morning is his sister.
grammar.tip: 人用 who；過去式 talked；to 要留

grammar.q: The smartphone ____ my father bought yesterday was cool but expensive.
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略

grammar.q: The boy ____ has a foreign-sounding name ____ from Germany.
grammar.tip: 主格關代用 who；The boy 單數 → comes

grammar.q: The popcorn ____ Janet bought is delicious. Do you want some?
grammar.tip: popcorn 是物，受格關代用 which

grammar.q: Vincent likes the girl ____ eyes are round and beautiful.
grammar.tip: girl 的眼睛 → whose + 名詞

grammar.q: We took a picture of the dolphin ____ jumped out of the water to get food.
grammar.tip: 關代當主詞不可省略，動物用 which

grammar.q: The plans Dan came up with ____ great, but it was hard to make them happen.
grammar.tip: 主詞 The plans 複數，過去式用 were

grammar.q: I don't know ____ Betty's husband is. Is he the one ____ she talked with a few minutes ago?
grammar.tip: 間接問句 who…is；人當先行詞用 that

grammar.q:
A: Do you want to try the lollipop ____ last night?
B: Sure. Is there anything special about it?
grammar.tip: which 當受詞，不可再加 them

grammar.q: Kate took me to ____ she was born. She also showed me many photos of her and her family.
grammar.tip: was born 後無介系詞 → 用 where

grammar.q:
A: Ian looks like a nice person.
B: He really is. I've known him for over ten years. He's a person ____.
grammar.tip: chat with 某人，介系詞 with 要留句尾

grammar.q: The comic book Rita lent me yesterday is the funniest one ____ I've ever read.
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略

grammar.q: The watch ____ Eric is looking for means a lot to him.
grammar.tip: watch 是物，受格關代用 which

grammar.q: The girl ____ cellphone was missing looked sad.
grammar.tip: girl 的手機 → whose + 名詞

grammar.q: Eddie really loves the gift ____ you gave him.
grammar.tip: gift 是物用 which；gave him 不需 to

grammar.q: Vivian sent a card ____ she bought in the UK to her friends.
grammar.tip: card 是物，用 that 引導關係子句

grammar.q: The men that I talked to last night ____ my friends.
grammar.tip: 主詞 The men 複數 → are

grammar.q: The guy ____ Amanda got a date with yesterday is a baseball player.
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略；人不用 which

grammar.q:
A: How can I comfort（安慰）a friend ____ pet dog died?
B: I have no idea.
grammar.tip: 朋友的狗 → whose + 名詞

grammar.q: Betty is the girl ____ hair is very short.
grammar.tip: girl 的頭髮 → whose + 名詞

grammar.q: Have you ever questioned if the report ____ you are reading is true?
grammar.tip: report 是物，受格關代用 which

grammar.q: Of all my classmates, Ben is the only one ____ I enjoy studying with before the exams.
grammar.tip: the only 修飾先行詞常用 that

grammar.q: The book ____ I spent a lot of time reading ____ was bought by my aunt.
grammar.tip: spend time V-ing 不需介系詞；物用 that

grammar.q: The movie theater ____ I went ____ with you was on fire this morning.
grammar.tip: go to 地方 → which…to

grammar.q: The girl ____ Eric likes is beautiful and smart.
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略

grammar.q: The computer game ____ you lent me yesterday is very interesting.
grammar.tip: 物當先行詞，受格關代用 that

grammar.q: The lady ____ is the boss of Zolli Candy.
grammar.tip: 省略關代：we'll interview the lady

grammar.q: The lady ____ to the clerk ____ fifty lemons.
grammar.tip: who is talking 修飾；動詞 needs

grammar.q: This is one of the thickest books ____ my father bought.
grammar.tip: 最高級修飾先行詞常用 that

grammar.q: The jacket ____ she bought is more expensive than the coat ____ I'm wearing.
grammar.tip: 物當先行詞用 which / that

grammar.q: The birthday cake ____ Christine's husband prepared was delicious.
grammar.tip: cake 是物，受格關代用 which

grammar.q:
A: Do you know the woman ____ name is Kuo Hsing-chun? I like her so much.
B: Is she the weightlifter（舉重選手）____ won a gold medal?
grammar.tip: whose + name；主格關代 that 不可省

grammar.q: Do you know the girl that we ____ last night?
grammar.tip: last night → 子句用過去式 met

grammar.q: He is a person ____ I really admire.
grammar.tip: person 是人，受格關代用 who(m)

grammar.q: Haven't you found anything ____ you are interested in?
grammar.tip: 受格關代可省略；不可用 what

grammar.q: Jenny is the girl ____ I talked last night.
grammar.tip: talk with 人；介系詞後用 whom

grammar.q: The students that Ms. White ____ are polite and hard-working.
grammar.tip: 子句主詞 Ms. White 單數 → teaches

grammar.q: We couldn't find the park ____ we used to play in before.
grammar.tip: 句尾有 in → 用 which；where 不可再加 in

fix.t: Actor David Piper [[became tired of]] talking about the movie [[he is famous]] [[after he was]] interviewed about it many times.
fix.tip: be famous for the movie，省略關代後介系詞 for 不可省

fix.t: Fiona [[loves listening to]] her children [[sing]] songs [[that learned]] at school.
fix.tip: 歌是孩子學的，子句需主詞：(that) they learned

fix.t: The comic book [[that I bought it]] last week [[was]] so funny that I [[have read]] it three times.
fix.tip: that 已代替受詞 book，子句內不可再用 it

fix.t: We [[enjoyed]] the movie [[who]] my brother [[recommended]].
fix.tip: movie 是物，受格關代用 which/that，不用 who

fix.t: Do you [[remember]] the boy [[who's]] bike [[was stolen]] in front of the library?
fix.tip: who's = who is；男孩的腳踏車 → whose + 名詞

fix.t: The singer [[who]] voice we heard on the radio [[is coming]] to our town [[next week]].
fix.tip: 歌手的聲音 → 所有格 whose + voice

fix.t: I [[can't stop]] eating the cookies my grandma [[make]] [[every]] Sunday.
fix.tip: 子句主詞 my grandma 單數，習慣動作用 makes

fix.t: The shoes [[that]] my sister [[bought]] last week [[is]] too small for her.
fix.tip: 主詞是 The shoes（複數），不是 sister → are

fix.t: The house [[that]] Mr. Lee [[lives]] [[has]] a big garden.
fix.tip: live in the house，介系詞 in 要留在句尾

fix.t: This is the park [[in that]] we [[used to]] play [[when]] we were kids.
fix.tip: 介系詞後不可接 that，要用 in which

fix.t: Have you [[called]] the girl [[I met her]] at the party [[yet]]?
fix.tip: 省略的關代已當受詞，不可再加 her

fix.t: I [[wrote]] [[a card]] to the teacher [[which]] I like the most.
fix.tip: teacher 是人，關代用 who/that，不用 which

fix.t: Jenny is the friend [[with that]] I [[went]] to the concert [[last Saturday]].
fix.tip: 介系詞後用 whom（人），不可用 that

fix.t: We stayed at a hotel [[which]] rooms [[were]] [[big and clean]].
fix.tip: 飯店的房間 → whose + rooms

fix.t: The pictures [[that]] Amy [[and her brother]] [[takes]] every summer are beautiful.
fix.tip: 子句主詞 Amy and her brother 複數 → take

fix.t: The cake I [[making]] for Mom's birthday [[was]] eaten [[by]] my dog.
fix.tip: 省略 that 的子句需動詞：(that) I made

fix.t: The students [[that]] Ms. Wang [[teaches]] [[being]] very polite.
fix.tip: 主詞 The students 需主要動詞，複數 → are

fix.t: I [[still]] [[ride]] the bike [[who]] my dad gave me.
fix.tip: bike 是物，關代用 which/that

fix.t: The man [[that]] you [[saw him]] at the bus stop [[is]] my uncle.
fix.tip: that 已當 saw 的受詞，不可重複 him

fix.t: This [[is]] [[the best]] movie [[what]] I have ever seen.
fix.tip: what 前不可有先行詞；最高級後用 that

fix.t: I [[know]] a girl [[whose]] parents [[is]] both doctors.
fix.tip: whose 後主詞 parents 複數 → are

fix.t: Kevin is the boy [[whose]] we [[saw]] at the park [[yesterday]].
fix.tip: whose 後須接名詞；此處當受詞用 who(m)/that

fix.t: The letter [[which]] I [[write]] to you last week [[has]] finally arrived.
fix.tip: last week 過去時間 → wrote

fix.t: The chair [[you are sitting]] [[is]] [[broken]].
fix.tip: sit on the chair，介系詞 on 不可省
